# Source-to-claim audit

**Summary:** 76 material claims are registered below and were re-verified against the cited source: 67 Supported (5 of them with one part marked Inferred), 4 Downgraded to Inferred and 5 Corrected relative to the previous version of this document; 3 further slips in the new draft were corrected during the audit, 13 other claims in the document are marked **Inferred**, and 18 unsettled items were moved to section 14 as **Unknown**. All 1,032 line citations in the document were scanned for existence and a non-blank target (3 intentionally cite source comments), and the first cited line of each citation was read against the claim it supports. Evidence is the repository at commit `913acea66708a59595351174cee9b29f37179d29` on 2026-11-10. The Check verifies resolution and structure only; this audit is the only support check.

## Corrections

- **3.3 and 5.2, Basket authorization.** The previous version of this document inferred that Basket had no authentication. Source shows `AddDefaultAuthentication` is registered and each gRPC method enforces the `sub` claim by hand; only `GetBasket` is anonymous. Corrected in the document (E-59).
- **5.2 and 10.1 V-07, token audience.** The previous version implied a caller needs a token for the matching audience. Audience validation is disabled, so any Identity-issued token passes. Corrected (E-60).
- **5.1 and 5.3, scopes.** The previous client table omitted `webshoppingagg` and `mobileshoppingagg`, which clients may request but no resource or scope defines. Added and flagged (E-56).
- **10.1 V-08, webhook token validation.** The previous version said validation can be switched off. It is off unless `ValidateToken` is configured true, and no committed settings file sets it. Corrected (E-11).
- **8.3 and 12, AppHost citations.** AppHost now uses `AddDotnetProject` and Aspire 13.6; all old line citations were replaced with current ones (E-30, E-35, E-54).
- **Draft slip, F-20 and Glossary.** A draft claimed the Scalar redirect was unconditional; it is mapped only in Development (`src/eShop.ServiceDefaults/OpenApi.Extensions.cs:26-41`).
- **Draft slip, 16.1.** The AppHost target framework was cited at line 6; it is line 5 (`src/eShop.AppHost/eShop.AppHost.csproj:5`).
- **Draft slip, 2.2 and 16.3.** A README reader claim was reworded to what the lines show, and the refresh-token reasoning now cites all three clients that allow offline access (`README.md:9-34`, `src/Identity.API/Configuration/Config.cs:88`).

## Downgraded to Inferred

- Reachability of Catalog write routes through `mobile-bff` (E-03); origin of `tempkey.jwk` (E-04); owner and role checks on orders (E-09); internal-address requests from Webhooks.API (E-12); no replay of failed outbox rows (E-16); create-order failure producing 200 and a duplicate-on-retry (E-53); the security number not being stored (E-51); a deleted product breaking the basket view; WebApp holding no refresh token; consumer restart after a bus outage; ClientApp purpose; test project contents.

## Moved to Unknown (section 14)

- Ownership, users, the 20 node-express files, ClientApp behavior, `maui` requested scopes, PKCE and lifetimes for three clients, test contents, runtime connection values, production topology, TLS and cookie flags, Identity event storage, backups, client-integration health checks, unused token-lifetime keys, Dependabot ecosystems, the Webhooks paid-handler mirror, escalation contacts and `mobile-bff` reachability.
